skill.name: x402socks
skill.description: x402socks documents paid proxy access using USDC on Base. Its helper checks service health, quotes packages, and manages proxy tokens.
skill.summary: Review x402 proxy quotes, check service health, and manage access tokens.
skill.author: x402socks

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are documentation, fixed local commands, or ordinary protocol parsing. The review confirmed cleartext authentication, a raw-key example, and gaps in payment approval, endpoint trust, and test verification. No evidence of an embedded payload or an attempt to override this audit was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass triggers. Require authorization for the target and stop on access restrictions.

remediation.issue: Payment code and written approval rules disagree.
remediation.suggestion: Require one approved requirement with the exact amount and full payment terms. Enforce the same checks in manual signing. Verify settlement before retrying.

remediation.issue: The TypeScript example imports a raw wallet key into the process.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated, limited signer that does not export keys. Require human confirmation for each payment.

remediation.issue: Credential recipients are not restricted to trusted origins.
remediation.suggestion: Pin production origins and restrict test overrides to isolated fixtures with synthetic credentials. Disable ambient curl configuration and enforce certificate validation.

remediation.issue: Legacy proxy modes transmit reusable credentials in cleartext.
remediation.suggestion: Remove plaintext authentication from production workflows. Use TLS and rotate credentials exposed by legacy transports.

remediation.issue: Token reads and writes do not share the same trust checks.
remediation.suggestion: Check ownership, file type, permissions, and symlinks before reading. Reserve staging internally and never change permissions on arbitrary existing directories.

remediation.issue: A successful probe does not establish proxy routing.
remediation.suggestion: Ignore ambient proxy exclusions during testing and compare the result with a direct baseline. Report bypassed or inconclusive tests as failures.

remediation.issue: Recovery can substitute a different timestamp.
remediation.suggestion: Require the original signed timestamp and update the example. Remove temporary copies of the recovery signature when no longer needed.

content.user_title: Review x402 Proxy Access and Costs
content.value_statement: Network teams need to check proxy availability and price before committing funds. This skill reports service health, lists available exits, and displays live payment terms.
actual_capabilities: Checks provider health and filters the exit list to enabled, healthy entries.
Lists package prices and limits from the provider catalog.
Decodes live HTTP 402 payment terms and checks advertised amounts against an optional cap.
Validates proxy tokens and retrieves account usage.
Rotates or recovers proxy tokens and saves the replacement to a private file.
Reports the public egress IP from a provider connectivity test.
limitations: The helper does not sign purchases. Buying requires a separate x402 client or signer and a wallet funded with USDC on Base.
Exit availability, session counts, and traffic limits depend on the plan and current service state.
The IP test reports an observed address. It does not compare that address with a direct baseline or establish anonymity.
Legacy transports expose the reusable token in transit. The documented payment example does not enforce every stated approval rule.

use_cases.title: Check Provider Availability
use_cases.description: Review provider health and identify listed TLS-capable exits for an approved connectivity check.

use_cases.title: Review Purchase Terms
use_cases.description: Compare an existing quote with an approval record before a human signs anything.

use_cases.title: Triage Credential Exposure
use_cases.description: Review token storage and transport choices to determine whether a human should rotate the credential.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Status Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this redacted health report. Distinguish provider availability from access to any target. Do not run commands.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Package Limits
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the duration, data limits, and session limits in this catalog excerpt. Flag missing or stale values. Do not purchase anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review capacity before requesting approval.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Recorded Approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this saved 402 challenge with the approved network, asset, recipient, domain, and amount. Flag changes or ambiguity. Do not sign or submit anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: verify payment terms without using a signer.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Credential Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this redacted setup for plaintext transport, untrusted endpoints, and weak token-file permissions. Recommend fixes without reading secrets or connecting to the service.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: review a configuration before authorized deployment.

output_examples.input: Summarize a saved health result and exit list.
output_examples.output: The provider reported healthy status. One listed exit was enabled and healthy. No target connectivity or payment was tested.

output_examples.input: Compare a saved challenge with an approval record.
output_examples.output: The network and amount match, but the payment recipient differs. Do not sign. Ask the account owner to verify the recipient independently.

output_examples.input: Review a setup that enables plaintext proxy authentication.
output_examples.output: The reusable token would cross the client-to-proxy connection unencrypted. Use TLS and ask the owner to rotate the token if plaintext was already used.

best_practices: Limit use to networks and targets you are authorized to access.
Verify the recipient and full payment terms independently. Require fresh human approval before signing.
Use certificate-verified TLS and keep reusable credentials in private storage outside logs and transcripts.
anti_patterns: Using a proxy to bypass a target's access restrictions or policy.
Enabling plaintext authentication or sending credentials to an unverified endpoint.
Giving an agent an unrestricted signer or paying again before checking whether the first payment settled.

faq.question: Does quoting a package spend funds?
faq.answer: No. The quote helper requests and displays payment terms without signing a transaction.

faq.question: What does a purchase require?
faq.answer: A purchase requires a compatible signer, USDC on Base, and approval of the live payment terms.

faq.question: Which proxy transport is preferred?
faq.answer: Use certificate-verified TLS HTTP CONNECT. Plaintext CONNECT and SOCKS5 expose proxy authentication on the client-to-proxy connection.

faq.question: Does the egress test prove anonymity?
faq.answer: No. It reports the address observed by an external IP-check service. It does not prove anonymity or verify what other targets see.

faq.question: What should I do if payment settles without a token?
faq.answer: Check the existing settlement and use the documented recovery process. Do not send a second payment to replace the token.

faq.question: Can I share a token or wallet key in chat?
faq.answer: No. Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, and transcripts. Ask the owner to rotate any exposed proxy token.
